A_base.base: man, age 38, long upper lip, strong straight nose, strong square chin, thick dark eyebrows, short dark brown hair, clean shaven

A_mustache.edit: add a full, neatly trimmed dark chevron moustache that covers the upper lip and ends at the mouth corners

A_pencil.edit: add a thin dark pencil moustache, a narrow neat line just above the edge of the upper lip, the rest of the lip bare

A_horseshoe.edit: add a dark horseshoe moustache whose sides run straight down past the mouth corners to the jawline

A_neglected.edit: make the moustache neglected: ragged uneven edge over the lip, stray long hairs, patchy regrowth

A_stubble.edit: add short dark stubble along the jawline, chin and lower cheeks

A_profile.edit: turn the head to an exact side profile facing left, so the nose, moustache and chin are seen from the side

B_base.base: man, age 30, short upper lip, light thin fair eyebrows, soft rounded jaw, light brown hair, clean shaven

B_thick.edit: add a thick bushy dark moustache that looks too heavy for his face

B_thin.edit: add a thin, sparse, wispy light-brown moustache with see-through gaps that is still clearly visible at a glance on the upper lip

beats.caption: WHY DO SOME MEN LOOK **BETTER** WITH ONE?
beats.vo: Why do some men look better with a moustache?

beats.caption: WHILE OTHERS JUST LOOK **CREEPY**?
beats.vo: While others with one just end up looking creepy?

beats.caption: A MOUSTACHE SITS ON YOUR **UPPER LIP**
beats.vo: A moustache sits on your upper lip, so a long lip gives it room.

beats.caption: IT FILLS THE GAP BETWEEN A **STRONG NOSE** AND CHIN
beats.vo: It fills the gap between a strong nose and a strong chin.

beats.caption: **PICK** YOUR SHAPE
beats.vo: Pick your shape first: a pencil leaves the lip bare.

beats.caption: A HORSESHOE **LENGTHENS** THE FACE
beats.vo: A horseshoe drops past the mouth and lengthens the whole face.

beats.caption: A CHEVRON KEEPS IT **LEVEL**
beats.vo: A chevron follows the lip line and keeps everything level.

beats.caption: IF YOUR BROWS ARE **THICK AND DARK**
beats.vo: If your brows are thick and dark, that's a good sign.

beats.caption: A FULL ONE **MATCHES** THEM
beats.vo: A full moustache matches them and balances the face.

beats.caption: IT LOOKS DELIBERATE WHEN IT'S **WIDER** THAN YOUR MOUTH
beats.vo: It looks deliberate when it's slightly wider than your mouth.

beats.caption: WITH **STUBBLE** ALONG THE JAW
beats.vo: And it pairs best with a little stubble along the jaw.

beats.caption: KEEP IT **TIDY**
beats.vo: Keep it tidy: ragged edges, stray hairs and patchy regrowth look neglected.

beats.caption: A SHORT LIP MEANS IT **CROWDS** THE NOSE
beats.vo: On a short upper lip, it crowds the nose and the mouth.

beats.caption: WITH **LIGHT BROWS** AND A SOFT JAW
beats.vo: Add light brows and a soft jaw, and nothing balances it.

beats.caption: THICK LOOKS **STUCK ON**, THIN LOOKS CREEPY
beats.vo: Thick looks stuck on, and thin just looks creepy on him.

beats.caption: A MOUSTACHE PULLS THE EYE TO THE **MIDDLE**
beats.vo: Because a moustache pulls the eye straight to the middle of the face.

beats.caption: **BETTER** OR CREEPY?
beats.vo: So a moustache only exaggerates what is already there.

beats.caption: IT COMES DOWN TO THE **FACE** AROUND IT
beats.vo: Whether it looks better or creepy comes down to the face around it.
